description:
As the world gets unnecessarily more complex: meetings to meet about... ahem... meetings--with this confusing backdrop, one bike--this bike--The Westlake--creates irrefutable simplicity. Lovely, glorious, wondrous simplicity through a wholehearted approach to being a bicycle. Not a gravel bike, not a road bike, not an enduro bike, not a KOM bike, PR bike, aero bike, training bike, or even aero training bike (it does exist, mind you). In a world of needless confusion, The Westlake provides straightforward bicycleness, one direct Shimano 1x9 shift at a time, as it should.
Simple and efficient 1 x 9 wide-range drivetrain keeps shifting crisp while retaining easy gearing for hills and hard gearing for fast flats
Dual alloy chainguards prevent the chain from falling off, even over rough terrain
Quality Tektro hydraulic brakes provide consistent, strong stopping power even in wet conditions
Lockout suspension fork allows for efficient pavement riding
Mid-width tires allows for efficient on-road or smooth off-road versatility
Alloy wheels, frame, and components stay rust free
